sources.note: No phonology section and no remark on tone, accent or stress for any lect; forms cited without tone marks except sporadic acutes (Duguri myél 'swallow'). Duguri data: li / lim / lin 'eat', myél / myelam / myelan 'swallow', san / sanam / sanan 'see', wa? / wa?am / wa?an 'hear'. Jaar perfect allomorphs conditioned on stem WEIGHT ('The stem is heavy when there are more than two consonants or where the vowel is long'); scanned 'Heavy stress ya?ad' is a misread of the table label 'Heavy stems'. Morphological data only.
